description: The thirty Omens drawn at dusk in CURFEW. One card per night, seeded server-side so every warband sees the same portent. Tilt values run from -2 (perilous) to +2 (favoured) per errand; an empty tilt is a flat night.

omens.title: The Ash Wind
omens.reading: The wind knows every street. It tells none of them.
omens.notes: Flat odds. Sifting turns up map ink rather than shards.

omens.title: The Drowned Bell
omens.reading: The sewers lie quiet. The taverns do not.
omens.notes: Sift safer, Carouse richer, Spy risky.

omens.title: The Hanged Merchant
omens.reading: Everything is for sale. Nothing is priced.
omens.notes: Trade doubles. Market tokens likelier.

omens.title: Green Light Under Ash
omens.reading: The comet remembers where it fell.
omens.notes: Sifting yields up. Collapses up.

omens.title: Sigmar's Hammer, Reversed
omens.reading: The Sisters are watching. So is something else.
omens.notes: Pray strong. Carouse and Spy penalised.

omens.title: The Rat King's Court
omens.reading: Something has been listening from below.
omens.notes: Whispers cheap. Sifting dangerous.

omens.title: The Empty Cradle
omens.reading: A quiet night. Too quiet.
omens.notes: Flat odds. Bonus Favour for any errand. A mercy card.

omens.title: The Lantern-Bearer
omens.reading: Someone is looking for you. They have not said why.
omens.notes: Rival glimpses likelier. Sight tokens likelier.

omens.title: The Comet
omens.reading: It has not finished falling.
omens.notes: Everything is richer and every risk is sharper. Curses likelier across the board.

omens.title: The Broken Bell
omens.reading: It still rings. Nobody agrees on the hour.
omens.notes: Blessings hold a night longer.

omens.title: The Fence's Scales
omens.reading: Old Henrik weighs everything twice. The second time is the price.
omens.notes: Shards convert at a better rate. Swindled likelier.

omens.title: The Plague Doctor
omens.reading: He does not knock. He counts.
omens.notes: Pray lucrative. Carouse dangerous.

omens.title: The Witch Hunter
omens.reading: A hat in the doorway. Nobody drinks.
omens.notes: Marked likelier. Trade quiet.

omens.title: The Crooked Dice
omens.reading: The bones lie. That is what they are for.
omens.notes: Bluffs pay double in Crooked Bones. Debts likelier.

omens.title: The Pit
omens.reading: The crowd came for blood. It is not particular whose.
omens.notes: Renown from the Pit doubles. Wagers pay out more.

omens.title: The Drowned Quarter
omens.reading: The river has come to see the ruins.
omens.notes: Map ink flows freely. Sifting slow.

omens.title: The Sisters' Candle
omens.reading: One window is lit. It has been lit all night.
omens.notes: The Shrine forgives one mistake.

omens.title: The Black Sails
omens.reading: A ship came up the Stir with no name on her. She is buying.
omens.notes: The Bazaar buys extra shards tonight.

omens.title: The Nameless Grave
omens.reading: The stone is blank. Somebody keeps it clean.
omens.notes: Chronicle lines run longer. Honoured dead may appear.

omens.title: The Whispering Wall
omens.reading: The walls here were built thin on purpose.
omens.notes: Rumours stay warm two nights longer.

omens.title: The Tower on the Rock
omens.reading: The chain is up. Nothing crosses without paying.
omens.notes: Ground tokens likelier.

omens.title: The Beggar King
omens.reading: He owns nothing and is owed by everyone.
omens.notes: Favour flows. Coin does not.

omens.title: The Cracked Hourglass
omens.reading: Time leaks. Take what you can carry.
omens.notes: Jobs advance two steps. Every risk is doubled.

omens.title: The Twin Moons
omens.reading: Two moons in one sky. Nothing stays hidden.
omens.notes: Morrslieb is full. Wyrdstone Cough likelier.

omens.title: The Sealed Door
omens.reading: Wax and a chain. Whatever is inside wants to stay.
omens.notes: Rival glimpses blocked. Standing orders pay full yield.

omens.title: The Wyrd Lantern
omens.reading: Someone found a way to burn it. Do not stand close.
omens.notes: Shards glow through rubble. Cough certain on a collapse.

omens.title: The Carrion Crown
omens.reading: The crows have chosen a king. He is not pleased.
omens.notes: Renown up. Marked likelier.

omens.title: The Ferryman
omens.reading: He asks one coin. He does not say for whom.
omens.notes: Epitaphs written tonight earn double Renown.

omens.title: The Bone Hand
omens.reading: Three charms, one palm. Choose.
omens.notes: Tokens drop on every errand. Full Hands must discard.

omens.title: The Last Candle
omens.reading: It will not last the night. Neither will the dark.
omens.notes: Blessings gutter faster. Pray pays double.
